t: Maya The Bee 2: The Honey Games
d: After a slow harvest season, the survival of the hive is threatened. Maya and Willy go to Buzztropolis, where the Empress invites them to participate in the Honey Games. But if they lose, the hive will have to give the Empress all of their summer honey!

When a take-charge alpha wolf and a laidback omega wolf get relocated halfway across the country, the two must set off on an incredible journey home in this CGI-animated adventure.
